scope: Decide only whether PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI remain an unanalyzed lexical pair or receive a family-specific governed PARAZAM- plus final-vowel contrast analysis. Do not decide a general final-I rule, general O/I part-of-speech morphology, new derivations, grammar or curriculum in B8.

evidence.semantic_relation: same study/learning domain; domain/place-like nominal reading vs action/study reading

constraints: One lexical pair cannot establish universal O=noun/domain or I=verb/action morphology.
B9 separately owns the question of final -I beyond this family.
PARAZAMO being FROZEN does not automatically freeze a morphological decomposition that was not historically recovered.
PARAZAMI remains WATCH; B8 analysis must not silently promote its lexical authority.
No new PARAZAM- derivatives are licensed by observing the pair.

options.description: Keep PARAZAMO and PARAZAMI as related lexical forms without a governed internal morphological analysis.
options.effect: Maximum conservatism; preserves the pair as evidence for B9 but creates no family-specific morphology.

options.description: Recognize PARAZAM- as a governed family-specific analytical stem and O/I as a closed contrast within this pair only. Treat the analysis as nonproductive and do not generalize O or I to the rest of HNK.
options.effect: Captures the unusually strong minimal-pair evidence while preserving B9 as the separate gate for any broader final-I hypothesis.

options.description: Generalize final O/I as productive nominal/domain versus verbal/action morphology.
options.effect: Not recommended; current evidence is insufficient and would pre-empt B9.
